meta.comparison: distance-weighted existing Landsat cells intersecting modelled shaded / unshaded open ground; not cooling or subpixel temperatures
meta.assumptions: scene-centre sun angles; flat ground; vertical extruded footprints; no trees/facades/terrain; context heights may be estimated; source dates differ; study-boundary occluders may be missing
meta.model: Sun-exposed open-ground weighted LST; this changes spatial sampling, not physical temperature
meta.metrics_source: Exact ground/shadow partitions from ground-shadow-v1; unchanged coarse raster values and 2.5m quadrature
